https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/44235:
Tenex builds frontier AI that works in the real world. Our engineers sit with C-suite leaders, find where AI adds the most value, and ship bleeding-edge AI to production.
  
  
We were founded in New York City in 2025. We are currently 70 people and will double by the end of the year. We build for Fortune 500 companies across media, healthcare, retail, finance, and sports.
  
  
Anthropic, OpenAI, and Cursor are partners where we turn technology into reliable systems businesses use every day.
  
  
**The Role**
You’ll own client projects end to end: find where AI adds real value, decide the technical plan, build the whole system, and keep improving it in production. You’ll lead a few projects at a time in a pod run by an engineering manager.
  
  
We look for engineers who:
  
  

* Have shipped and supported production software.
* Have built reliable systems with LLMs.
* Can explain decisions to a CEO or an engineer.

You will learn to structure work for agents, engineer context, evaluate outputs, and decide where people stay in control. Every project leaves behind agent systems, evals, and tools that make the next one faster.
  
  
The engineers we put in front of clients are the product, so hiring is the most important decision we make each week. Our engineers have worked at Google, Meta, Amazon, Microsoft, AWS, DoorDash, Coinbase, and Oracle, and many have founded companies.
  
  
**Our Work**

* Sales intelligence for a sports and entertainment company. Models score 4.1M fans every night, and an LLM explains each score for sales reps. Top-ranked fans buy at 125x the rate of fans who are not called.
* Shelf and field intelligence for a beauty brand. Revenue forecasts for every shelf move, field staffing optimization, and AI checks of shelf photos. Fixing the retailer data feed alone recovered about $1M a week in sales.
* In-store computer vision for a retail analytics company. Vision models run on edge devices in each store. They count 98% of entries with zero false counts, and store no video or faces.
* AI legal review for true-story TV scripts at a global media company. Attorneys start from an AI first pass that flags defamation, false light, and privacy risks. A review that took about 7 hours now takes about 1.

**How We Pay**
Most pay models were built before AI changed how fast engineers can work. Ours wasn’t: you get a base salary plus an uncapped quarterly bonus based on the work you ship, so the more you do with AI, the more you earn. Last quarter, every full-quarter engineer beat their baseline.
  
  
OTE $224K-$394K
  
  

* Offers Equity
* Offers Bonus
* 55/45 split

**How We Work**
Tenex is intense by design. The pace is fast, and the standards are high. People share what they learn, challenge each other, and step in to help, so the bar is high and so is the support.
  
  
This is probably not the right place if you want a narrow scope, a predictable pace, or distance from customers. It is built for engineers who want responsibility, hard problems, and a steep learning curve.
  
  
**Our Vision**
We’re bootstrapped and profitable, and we reinvest what we earn into tools, research, and products of our own. Over time, that’s how we build a modern-day Bell Labs: a place where solving today’s problems gives us the means to tackle bigger ones.
  
  
Compensation Range: $224K - $394K

**About Us**
At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.
  
  
We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
The ViaSat Access Edge Terminal Software team is responsible for the design, development, delivery and support of software running on embedded satellite terminal products (Ka-band, L-band, 5G) that are used in aviation, maritime, residential and other sectors.
  
  
You’ll be a software engineer working as part of a software team with a technical lead. You will be engaging & collaborating with other software teams working on embedded software, to achieve development, design, quality and agility goals.
  
  
**The day-to-day**

* Software engineering as part of an agile development team
* Design, develop and drive software products
* Participate in design, development and code reviews of software with a view to deliver quality products in the short and long term
* Collaborate & coordinate with other software engineers and teams in driving timely delivery of quality software
* Produce software as an individual contributor.
* Travel up to 10%

This position is site-based. Site based employees work 3+ days (60%+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five day work week. While this means employees are mostly and consistently onsite, Viasat embraces a flexible work environment.
  
  
**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in computer science or computer engineering
* 3-5 years of experience in hands-on software development using C/C++ and Python
* 3-5 years of experience with Linux/UNIX
* Hands-on experience with Objected Oriented methodology & development
* Experience with using AI tooling in software development.
* Strong analytical skills & ability to evaluate software design, including existing codebases
* Strong sense of ownership
* Excellent communication skills
* Ability to collaborate and communicate in a team environment and with other engineering teams
* Being detail oriented with strong analytical problem-solving skills

**What Will Help You On The Job**

* Experience using C/C++, Python, Rust
* Experience writing unit tests for C/C++, Python, Rust
* Experience with Posix and Bash shell scripting
* Experience with build infrastructure tools such as GitHub Actions and Jenkins
* Experience with Linux kernel development
* Understanding of multiheaded programming and applications
* Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., git)
* Coursework or familiarity with RF and satellite communications principles
